description: Choose keyword search or direct business lookup, then set review depth and filters.

categories.description: Optional Yelp category aliases or names used to narrow search results, for example 'pizza', 'coffee', or 'home_services'. They are combined with the search query.
categories.title: Categories

includeReviews.description: Turn off to collect only business profiles and skip the review feed.
includeReviews.title: Include reviews

location.description: City, neighborhood, or ZIP code to search in mode=search, for example 'New York, NY' or '10012'.
location.title: Location

maxItems.description: Hard cap on business records in the dataset. Search is limited to Yelp's 240-result ceiling per query.
maxItems.title: Maximum businesses

maxReviewsPerBusiness.description: Maximum reviews collected for each business. Reviews are paged 49 at a time from Yelp's public review feed.
maxReviewsPerBusiness.title: Reviews per business

minRating.description: Drop businesses rated below this value. Set to 0 to keep every rating.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

mode.description: Search Yelp by keyword and location, or look up specific business URLs, aliases, or 22-character business IDs.
enumTitles: Search Yelp by keyword and location
Scrape specific business URLs or IDs
mode.title: Mode

price.description: Optional price levels for mode=search. Leave empty for every price level.
price.title: Price levels

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor automatically uses Apify Proxy when Yelp blocks a request; add a country or custom proxy here only when you need a specific route.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

reviewLanguage.description: Language for the review feed. Choose 'all' to page through every language Yelp reports for the business.
reviewLanguage.title: Review language

reviewRatings.description: Only collect reviews with these star ratings. Choose one or more values.
reviewRatings.title: Review star ratings

reviewSort.description: Ordering applied to each business's review feed.
reviewSort.title: Review order

searchQuery.description: Keyword to search for in mode=search, for example 'pizza', 'plumber', or 'coffee shop'.
searchQuery.title: Search query

startUrls.description: In mode=search, paste Yelp search URLs. In mode=direct, paste business URLs, aliases, or 22-character business IDs.
startUrls.title: Start URLs

title: Yelp Scraper Input
